desc: The stone spikes crack, crumble and sink back into the ground one by one from left to right, rock chunks fall and settle, dust clouds roll outward along the ground and thin out, the amber glow in the crack cools and darkens until only a faint crack and a little rubble remain.
subject: ground fissure with erupting stone spikes
pose: the stone spikes fully raised, dust rolling

desc: The dust and misty dirt clouds keep spreading low and wide along the ground while thinning into fine drifting particles, mud chunks fall back down and settle, the center flash fades, until only a faint crater ring remains.
subject: a landing impact with dust clouds and crater
pose: the impact at its peak, dust bursting out

desc: The golden hexagon dome shimmers, its facets flicker and break apart into small glowing shards that drift upward and fade, the ground ring flash dims, dust clouds roll outward and thin away.
subject: a landing impact with a golden hexagon barrier dome
pose: the dome fully formed, dust bursting

desc: The crescent slash arc thins from the tail toward the tip, breaks into small glowing fragments and streaks that drift along the swing direction and fade out, sparks fall and dim, until nothing remains.
subject: a diagonal sword-slash crescent arc of light with sparks
pose: the slash arc at full brightness

desc: The falling slash arc thins and breaks apart into glowing fragments that fade out, the sparks at the strike point fall and dim, mud bits fall back, the short ground crack stays faintly then fades.
subject: a falling sword-slash arc striking the ground
pose: the arc at full brightness striking the ground

desc: The two crossing slash arcs thin from their tails, split into glowing fragments and streaks that scatter outward and fade, the star flash at the crossing shrinks and vanishes, sparks fall and dim.
subject: two crossing sword-slash arcs in an X with a spark flash

desc: The rune circle keeps glowing and slowly rotates, the light-chains pulse and slowly sink into the ground, small sparks rise, then the glow gradually dims to a faint outline and fades out.
subject: a glowing steel-blue rune circle on the ground with chains of light

desc: The golden light column keeps rising upward and thins out from the bottom, embers and light motes float up and fade, the ground sigil slowly dims and fades away.
subject: a golden light column rising from a ground sigil
pose: the light column at full height
